The '''Council of Exploration Corps Masters''' was a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that oversaw the internal affairs of the [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]]. Answering to the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]] and working closely with the [[Republic Survey Corps/Legends|Republic Survey Corps]] and [[Intergalactic Zoological Society]], the Council was formed of several ranking masters.<ref name="TJP" />
